# Search samples

These saved, synthetic API answers use the provider-documented response fields and example.org URLs. No live keys, paid calls or user content were used. Each engine file includes the expected transport and parsed result. The adapters contain the corresponding public source URLs and pricing check date (2026-11-09, or 2026-11-13 for the new image adapters).

Brave: https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/documentation/image-search
Exa: https://exa.ai/docs/reference/search
Tavily: https://docs.tavily.com/documentation/api-reference/endpoint/search
Serper: https://serper.dev/
